lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing the map where the asphalt meets the clover
Watching the gears of the city turn over
Concrete cathedrals rising under a charcoal sky
Watching the ghosts of the old world pass by
Every brick holds a secret, every street has a name
Searching for a spark in the center of the flame
Walking the line between the hunger and the peace
Finding the rhythm where the heavy shadows release
[Chorus]
Flowing like water through the stone and the clay
Chasing the light at the edge of the day
Grounding the soul where the wild meets the wire
Lifting the spirit, climbing higher and higher
[Verse]
Planting the seeds in the cracks of the pavement
Finding the truth in the words that we haven't
Measured by clocks but driven by inner design
Tracing the curves where the human and nature entwine
Built by the hand, shaped by the spirit of old
Turning the silver of stories into heavy gold
Breathing in deep as the skyline begins to sway
Carrying the weight of the words left to say
[Chorus]
Flowing like water through the stone and the clay
Chasing the light at the edge of the day
Grounding the soul where the wild meets the wire
Lifting the spirit, climbing higher and higher
[Bridge]
The roots run deep beneath the noise of the street
Where the pulse of the earth and the city heart meet
[Chorus]
Flowing like water through the stone and the clay
Chasing the light at the edge of the day
Grounding the soul where the wild meets the wire
Lifting the spirit, climbing higher and higher
[Outro]
